text:
maya: Morning async — quick standup: saw EU embed latency spike last night around 08:45 UTC. p50 jumped to ~1.1s (normal ~0.45s). I opened an alert run and it paged oncall twice. I disabled the noisy dedupe rule to stop repeat pages; created ticket #7892 for follow-up.
sam: Link to graphs + runbook?
maya: Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/embeds?panelId=23&from=2026-03-17T07:30:00Z&to=2026-03-17T09:00:00Z — runbook: https://wiki.redwood/inference/runbooks/embed-latency
leo: Canary traffic was at ~15% during that window. Was the quantized variant rolled out last deploy?
rachel: I shipped a KV eviction adjustment in the last deploy (PR 4321) that shortens warmup TTL. Could interact with cold-cache paths.
aditya: pinging for a quick CR review on a small revert (PR 4333) if we want to roll back the eviction tweak fast.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17_07:00 by rachel succeeded on infra-stage (sha ab12c).
alex: I muted the pager for that alert while we triage. Left a note in PD incident #INC-2026-118.
maya: Actions I took: disabled dedupe (temp), muted pager, created ticket #7892, annotated the runbook with initial findings. Commands I ran: `dune query --metric embed_p50_eu --from 2026-03-17T07:30:00Z --to 2026-03-17T09:00:00Z` and `kubectl logs -n inference embed-service-7f4 --since=2h | grep eviction`.
sam: Proposed short-term mitigations: 1) increase alert threshold by +20% for EU embed for next 6h, 2) add a rate-based suppress for repeated same-instance pages, 3) rollback PR 4321 if we confirm correlation. Thoughts?
rachel: Agree with temp threshold bump. I'll prioritize a quick A/B: revert in staging + run the canary for 30m. If stable, we can promote revert.
aditya: I'll do CR review now (ETA 20m). If approved I can trigger a staging revert rollout.
leo: Also worth checking warmup coverage — if eviction TTL trimmed, we might need an explicit warmup during scale events. Filed a subtask on #7892.
maya: Owners: rachel for revert test, aditya for CR, leo for warmup checklist, sam to update alert rule. Oncall handoff: alex -> maya at 12:00 UTC.
alex: noted. I'll add a short playbook comment under PD incident and hand off in 20m. :+1:
maya: Quick checklist for whoever picks this up next: 
- confirm staging revert behavior within 30m
- run `dune synth --preset warmup-eu --target 50qps` to validate warmup
- update alert threshold and add 6h suppress window if we see repeat flapping
- link any follow-up PRs to ticket #7892
Thanks — will update here after staging test.
aditya: CR is up, comments left. will ping when ready.
rachel: started staging revert now, posting results in 25m.
ops-bot: reminder: weekly-oncall-rotation starts 2026-03-18 00:00 UTC.
maya: cool — small follow-ups tomorrow: add a regression check in our nightly evals to catch embed p50 > 0.8s for EU.
sam: ack.
leo: thanks team.
maya: closing the loop — staging revert looked fine, warmup test passed, increasing alert threshold for 6h. Added postmortem stub to ticket #7892. Will schedule a proper write-up if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
